lines.zh: 步子很沉，紫色的布在晃。
lines.en: Heavy steps; the violet cloth sways.

lines.zh: 我戴着小礼帽，头抬得很直。
lines.en: Top hat on, head held very straight.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，颜料都变暗。
lines.en: Paint darkens where I walk.

lines.zh: 大脚掌踩在地板上，没有响。
lines.en: My wide feet land without a sound.

lines.zh: 我经过吧台，杯子轻轻抖。
lines.en: Passing the counter, cups tremble.

lines.zh: 我不看路，路的尽头都是黑的。
lines.en: I do not watch the path. Its end is black.
My body is a little thicker than the wall.
I drag my steps, as if waiting for someone.
Tiny claws still on my hands.

lines.zh: 我走进去，房间就暗下来。
lines.en: I enter, and the room darkens.
I walk along the stage edge.
The lamps cannot pierce this body.
Standing, my hat brim low.
This violet body reflects little.
I wait for all the lights to die.
An old patch on my chest.
I am still, yet the room moves around me.
My arms hang at my sides.
My mouth has never closed.

lines.zh: 我数着天花板上的灯管。
lines.en: I count the tubes in the ceiling.
The corner lamp flickered.
I am thinking how to make you stay.
You stepped below the stage.
This violet black will not wash out.

lines.zh: 你的手电在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your torch is shaking; I noticed.
You know who I am.
Do not come so close.
My mouth is always open.

lines.zh: 你听见后台的声音了吗。
lines.en: Do you hear the noise backstage?
This building has only one path.
Turn your head and look at me.
A patch of violet cloth has torn.
I sway and my hat goes crooked.
Something structural inside has snapped.
I cast no shadow, yet I move.
The plastic creaks.
I shifted back half a step.
The violet has thinned.
I am still on the stage.
You broke my rhythm.

lines.zh: 台上有东西，是谁留下的。
lines.en: Something on the stage. Who left it?
Leave it on the stage edge.
That interests me.
Do not take it away. I want to see.
Give it and I will stay still.
That smells like old cake.
Your bag is too full.
Hold it a little higher.
That counts as a gift.
Set it down slowly. Do not drop it.
You bumped into my chest.
I did not give half a step.
The violet cloth brushed against you.
Steady. The floor is slick.
Do not grab my bow tie.

lines.zh: 你的肩骨碰到我的塑料。
lines.en: Your shoulder met my plastic.

lines.zh: 这身铁壳，推得动才算怪。
lines.en: This iron shell — good luck pushing it.
Go around. I am going up.
You stepped on my foot.
Do not hurry me. I am slow.
This violet black does not suit it.
The stage does not welcome that.
I have other plans.
Do not stand at this distance.
I cannot even be bothered to speak.
Can you see my hands?
That requires someone alive.
Get back below the stage.
I bend, and my hat slips.
I scoop it up with one hand.

lines.zh: 台边掉的东西，是剧场的。
lines.en: Things at the stage edge belong to the theater.
This small one is light.
I tuck it into my hat.
Not mine, but I keep it.
My palm is too broad to pinch it.
The thing on the floor glows.
I pick it up slowly.
Do not snatch it. That is mine.
You are still on this floor.
You are on my stage.
The lights will not come back this time.
I know your shadow.
Do not run backstage.
First I block the way.
Turn around and look at me.
Slow your steps and you are finished.
This fight is on the stage.
Do you hear the bell?
My hand has risen.
Do not let the child see.
I cannot smile, but I am waiting.
Every light on this floor is out.
One step of yours, one lamp dies.
My hat blocks a lamp.
I do not need to see you clearly.
Your steps echo.

lines.zh: 台下的椅子排得整整齐齐。
lines.en: The seats below are neatly in rows.
I wait for every light to die.
Something moves in the shadow behind you.

lines.zh: 再近一点，你就进我怀里。
lines.en: One step closer and you're in my arms.

lines.zh: 步子很慢，可我一直没停。
lines.en: Slow steps, but I never stop.
Your hand is hunting for a handle.
This door is locked fast.
There is a beat in my head.
You can hear it too, can you not?
This will do nicely.
Right in front of you.
The lights are all out now.
I have drawn near.
My palm comes down.
My foot pins yours.
A violet hand closes on your neck.

lines.zh: 这一下，把椅子都撞翻了。
lines.en: That one knocks over the chairs.
I shove you into the wall.
My little claws rake down.
You are dragged across the stage.
I bite once, then let go quickly.
A violet hand reaches from behind.
The floor takes a fresh groove.
I add one more blow.
That one landed with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的手，可抓不住。
lines.en: You grab my hand, but cannot hold it.
I lift you a little.
When I set you down, you are limp.
See? I am still standing.
I win this round.

lines.zh: 别叫，台上的客人会吓到。
lines.en: Do not cry out. The guests will be startled.
I come from the dark backstage.

lines.zh: 帽子先露出来，然后是我。
lines.en: The hat appears first, then the rest of me.
Half the stage lights went out.
The dark here is thick enough.

lines.zh: 我站在台中央，慢慢抬头。
lines.en: I stand center stage and slowly look up.
The seats are empty.

lines.zh: 我的脚下有旧漆的味道。
lines.en: Old paint smell under my feet.

lines.zh: 这一场演出，只为一个人。
lines.en: This show is for one person only.
I have no voice, only footsteps.
The lights cannot find me.
I lift my chin.
Let me see tonight's guest.
Fire singes the cloth. A strange smell.
My hat lands first.
The cloth soaks up water and grows heavy.
The blast lifts my cloth.
An arrow sticks in my hat.
This light cuts through the violet black.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我在衰弱。
lines.en: I do not eat, yet I weaken.

lines.zh: 电把我的关节烧得发亮。
lines.en: Lightning makes my joints glow.
There is no stage below.
